text: Got this exact card a few days ago for $359 CDN ($249 US). Did a few benchmarks before and after the VBIOS update. XFX site claims a 7% increase with new BIOS. Ryzen 5 2600X, 16GB 3200 CL14 DDR4. I saw a 3.5-4% gain. Timespy was 6707 and Rise of the Tomb Raider was 93.7fps w/ old BIOS. 6977 and 97.7fps w/ new BIOS. No 7% gains there. Base clock is up from 1460 to 1560. Max clock up from 1642 to 1753. 100W max draw on the old BIOS, 114W max on the new BIOS. Saw jumps to 130W in Lobby screen in COD Warzone. Getting 120-140 FPS in that game on High Settings. Temps have never gone over 89C junction, or 79C GPU. Have not tried any overclocking. Hope this helps. Good upgrade from my GTX 1060 3GB. Double FPS in most games on higher quality settings.
